Title: Emma Heming Willis on her husband Bruce Willis's illness: 'Once I stopped being in denial, we've learned to just navigate the disease'
Description: The actor learned he was suffering from a neurodegenerative disease at 67. Close to four years after the diagnosis, his wife describes how she coped with the illness and her new role as a caregiver.

Title: At Loewe, Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez make their mark
Description: Succeeding Jonathan Anderson as creative directors at Loewe, the two Americans have lived up to expectations, offering fashion that combines pragmatism, technical experimentation and respect for the codes of the Spanish luxury brand. They will show their spring-summer 2027 collection in early October in Paris.

Title: Inside the Hamidovic clan's reign of terror over young female pickpockets in the Paris métro
Description: They name their children Dior or Al Capone and love designer clothes and luxury cars. To maintain their lavish lifestyle, the men of the Hamidovic clan – a Romani family of Bosnian origin – have maintained a reign of fear over an army of young female pickpockets on Paris public transportation. One branch of the network is on trial in Paris from September 15 to 23.
